protocol.hypothesis: Test whether the mechanical bollinger-confirmed-breakout interpretation improves month-level outcomes over the same-stock buy-and-hold control.

trader_attribution.name: John Bollinger
trader_attribution.rule_interpretation: Two consecutive closes outside the same Bollinger Band; exit at middle band. The published Method IV also uses ADX, omitted here as a deliberate isolated test.

protocol.parameter_rationale: Two preregistered lookbacks bracket the published/default horizon; this is a bounded first grid, not a claim that all possible settings were searched.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
protocol.signal_rule: Two consecutive closes outside the same Bollinger Band; exit at middle band. The published Method IV also uses ADX, omitted here as a deliberate isolated test. All signals use completed bars and next-open fills; no current incomplete higher-timeframe bar.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research ranking only; no automatic trading approval
limitations: Author's discretionary choices are not reproduced

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
